title: Invocation Request
description: The External Invocation Adapter's inbound public contract, introduced in DC-003-I010 — the first stable boundary between the DC-003 platform and any external system (n8n, a future REST API, a scheduler, a batch process, a future GUI). request_id is supplied by the caller, never generated by the adapter. correlation_metadata is opaque — stored and echoed back on the response unchanged, never interpreted.

topic_package_reference.description: Exactly one of file_path (a path the adapter loads and validates, same shape as the Pipeline Orchestrator's own configuration.topicPackageSource.filePath) or data (an already-parsed object) — never both, never neither.

execution_options.description: Reserved for future use — deliberately minimal for DC-003-I010. Validated as a plain object but no field currently changes execution behavior.

correlation_metadata.description: Opaque to the adapter — stored and returned unchanged on the InvocationResponse, never interpreted or validated beyond being an object.
